en: We'll go ahead with the meeting as originally planned.
I did exactly what the manual says, so why isn't it working?

ko: 첨부한 양식대로 작성하여 금요일까지 제출해 주시기 바랍니다.
en: Please fill it out following the attached form and submit it by Friday.
glosses: 양식=form, template; 작성하다=to fill out; 제출하다=to submit

en: Just as I expected, the traffic is terrible.

ko: 어젯밤에 드라마 보느라 한숨도 못 잤어.
en: I was up watching a drama last night and didn't sleep a wink.
glosses: 어젯밤=last night; 드라마=TV drama; 한숨도 못 자다=to not sleep a wink

ko: 보고서 쓰느라 점심을 거의 못 먹었어요.
en: I was busy writing a report and barely got to eat lunch.

ko: 다른 회의에 참석하느라 전화를 못 받았습니다.
en: I was in another meeting, so I couldn't take your call.
glosses: 참석하다=to attend; 전화를 받다=to answer the phone

en: Sorry for the late reply; I was busy wrapping up a project.
glosses: 마무리하다=to wrap up; 답장=reply; 늦다=to be late

ko: 이사 준비하느라 요즘 정신이 하나도 없어.
en: I've been so busy getting ready to move, I can't think straight.
glosses: 이사=moving house; 정신이 없다=to be frazzled
